vendor.method: AI Elements registry items (https://elements.ai-sdk.dev/api/registry/<name>.json) installed with shadcn CLI 4.23.0 into the base-luma project (`npx shadcn@4.23.0 add <url> --dry-run --view`), then adapted
changes: Type steps and weights of DESIGN.md section 8: text-sm and text-xs become text-body and text-meta; no font-medium outside a title

prompt-input: the text composer only (PromptInput, Body, Textarea, Header, Footer, Tools, Button, Submit); attachments, screenshots, referenced sources, the model select, hover cards, tabs and the cmdk command menu are removed (Sidekick's bridge takes text only; cmdk is banned in first-party code); PromptInput takes a groupClassName for its InputGroup; tooltip buttons render through the trigger (no nested button)
message: the branch picker (button-group) and the Streamdown cjk, code, math and mermaid plugins are removed; the user bubble takes Luma's rounded-3xl

tool: a state is a dot and its word through Badge (DESIGN.md 4.3), with plain labels; ToolInput and ToolOutput (code-block) are removed, Norn draws the tool's view; the trigger has the 2px focus outline
conversation: the scroll and download buttons carry screen-reader names; centring uses start-1/2 with its RTL counterpart
confirmation: actions use the sm Button size; suggestion: buttons at weight 400
